LanguageData.RP_DeployEvacTip: Mark up to two places to gather (a yard, a kept room or the holding patch) and which security levels each takes. When a fire reaches a wing with people in it (or a solitary cell beside it - the hole is evacuated with its wing) you are offered to evacuate it (here too, and nothing starts by itself) - minimum and medium inmates walk to a place on a route of their own, where the doors on it open for them and no other; maximum, supermax, the hole, death row, the downed and anyone with no way they may walk alone wait for a guard, who walks them out with the escort's pass or carries them. Supermax goes only to a cage of its own, one at a time, or waits in the cell. Nobody is sent into fire; with no place that can be reached they go to the nearest safe room they may enter. After an hour with no fire in the wing, or on your word, everyone goes back to their own bed. A drill runs the same without a fire, and a real fire takes over from it.
LanguageData.RP_EvacPointsNone: No assembly point marked - an evacuation needs one for the wing's level, or everyone goes to the nearest safe room.
LanguageData.RP_EvacPointLevelsTip: The security levels this point takes. A yard of its own (supermax) takes its own level only by default, and supermax is only ever sent to a yard of its own, one inmate at a time. A second point is where those kept apart (one of each keep-apart pair or feud), protective custody and the threatened (the gang's green light) go.
LanguageData.RP_EvacMarkSecond: Mark a second point, to keep people apart
LanguageData.RP_EvacMarkTip: Pick a yard, a kept room or the holding patch as the place everyone gathers. Not visitation - the public comes in there, and it has a door to the outside.
LanguageData.RP_EvacMarkSecondTip: A second place, away from the first, for keep-apart pairs, protective custody and the threatened.
LanguageData.RP_EvacMarkNone: No yard, kept room or holding patch is painted that is not marked already
LanguageData.RP_EvacStartTip: Empty the {0} - walkers go to the assembly point by themselves, the rest wait for a guard to walk or carry them. Nobody is sent into fire.
LanguageData.RP_EvacDrillTip: Run an evacuation of a wing without a fire, to find a bad route before a real emergency. It costs the guards their time and each inmate it moves a small mood memory for a day, and the letter at the end names the slowest arrival and any route that was blocked. One drill a day.

LanguageData.RP_EvacAllClearTip: End it now - everyone walks or is escorted back to their own bed, and the passes end. Not while the wing still burns, and a fire in it on the way back turns everyone out again. Anyone whose own cell burns (a cell outside the wing) waits where they are until it is out, and holds the end up to three hours. It ends by itself an hour after the last fire in the wing.
